name: Read the Forbidden
body:
School divination; Level bard 1, wizard (only) 1, summoner 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (any holy symbol)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 minute

DESCRIPTION

The arcane version of librum sanctus, it behaves the same way except for the consumption of the holy symbol during the casting; a ‘1’ rolled on the Use Magic Device attempt always results in a mishap (2d6 damage) and the caster must make a Will 15 save or be shaken for 1 hour per spell level of the scroll attempted. If this procedure is used in the presence of a divine caster of the same faith as the holy symbol being used as a material component, they will likely be quite hostile to the caster.
